decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project or key milestone despite 1 invite sent (facts). Customer replied politely but disengaged — "will reach out if anything comes up" [email:c5a57f5c], no questions, no tickets. Engagement exists but no self-driven setup momentum; 8 days left leaves moderate chance of unaided activation.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the note — glad the first week has gone smoothly for you and your teammate, and no worries on questions; I'm here whenever something comes up.

One thing that tends to make Wrenfield click early: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project shaped around real work is usually the turning point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and help you map your first project to how your team already works. Just name a time.

Best,
Nadia
